name: presentation_profile
description: Which generated views to render for this slot: the property table alone, or the property table plus a compact pseudo-IDL appendix.

aiGuidance.purpose: Controls the generator's output shape. 'property-table' is the primary reader view (#274 ratified ledger); 'property-table-and-pseudo-idl' adds the optional compact appendix. The raw JSON Schema is always linked, never embedded.
